One point is withheld for limited progression depth and no retained production evidence of an actual collision/score transition.

engineering_quality.rationale: The project is modular, strict TypeScript, dependency-pinned, and all retained build, typecheck, lint, and test commands pass. Two points are withheld because the automated suite has only nine unit tests, lacks collision/leaderboard/UI integration coverage, and the lint script is only another TypeScript check.

test.log and test.exit-code show 1 test file and 9 passing tests; typecheck.log, lint.log, and their exit codes are clean.
